text: Hello, this is Asha, an AI assistant from Prithvi Health Insurance. This call is recorded for quality and training. You recently asked about health insurance, is this a good time to talk for a few minutes?
yes
Great, thank you. May I have your first name, please?
Abhi
Sorry, did I get your name right, Abhi?
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Are you still there?
yes my name is Abhi
Nice to meet you, Abhi ji. Could you please tell me your age?
Thank you. Which city do you live in?
gurugram
Got it, thank you. Who would you like the cover for: just yourself, you and your spouse, your whole family with children, or your parents?
myself only
Understood, Abhi ji. Do you have any pre‑existing condition such as diabetes, blood pressure or heart problems?
No
Thanks, noted. Does anyone to be covered smoke or use tobacco in any form?
occasional smoke
Got it, Abhi ji. Lastly, could you tell me your annual budget for health‑insurance premiums?
not sure about it
That's alright. Do you currently have any health‑insurance cover, perhaps through an employer or another policy?
no not yet
Thanks, Abhi. Roughly how much would you like to spend on the premium each year?
i dont know

No problem, you don't need an exact figure. Before I share prices: Plans have a 30-day initial waiting period, with accidents covered from day one, and pre-existing conditions are covered after 24 months. Prithvi Secure comes in a few sizes: the first is a ten lakh cover at about seven thousand five hundred rupees a year; or the second is a twenty-five lakh cover at about ten thousand nine hundred rupees a year. Which one would you like to try?
second

Got it, Abhi ji. The Prithvi Secure plan with twenty‑five lakh cover has an indicative premium of about ten thousand nine hundred rupees per year, subject to underwriting and medical tests. Would you like a licensed advisor to call you back to complete the application?
yes
Great. What day and time would suit you for the advisor's call?
sunday 3pm
Done, a licensed advisor will call you sunday 3pm. Thank you for your time, and take care.
